text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and analyse written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers can tell if a piece of text is positive, negative, or neutral. You can also find NLP in chatbots, which answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and more helpful.
